title: VFD
description: The vacuum fluorescent display of a hi-fi deck, glass only: herb's top songs play as a now-playing sequence with the title scrolling across 16-segment characters, a racing time counter and a spectrum meter. Scroll or drag to skip and every segment redraws; hold to fast-forward.
intent: One glowing piece of glass made real: blue-green phosphor segments with ghosts of the unlit ones, the honeycomb grid and filament wires in front of them, bloom around every lit stroke, and a meter that dances to herb's own beat when sound is on.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (spinning CD, hi-fi glow)
